courses.title: Virtual Practice Evenings with Frans Stiene 2027 Full Membership
courses.description: A twelve-month membership for live online Reiki practice groups led by Frans Stiene twice a month, from January to December 2027. Sessions last an hour and are open to practitioners and teachers of any lineage who want to practise the system of Reiki from a Japanese perspective.

courses.title: Live Online Video Intensive Reiki Precept Chanting Event
courses.description: A two-hour live online session chanting the Reiki precepts together in Japanese, in six twenty-minute rounds. Open to Reiki practitioners and teachers of any lineage, and recorded for those who cannot attend live.

courses.title: New Year Online Reiki Retreat 2027 2-3 January
courses.description: A live online retreat of two hours a day over two days, in which Frans explains the inner meaning of traditional Japanese Reiki practices and leads them with the group. Open to all lineages, with recordings available afterwards on the Ki Campus.

courses.title: 11 Hour Video Teaching: The Japanese Way of Reiki
courses.description: Eleven pre-recorded one-hour videos, each with half an hour of teaching and half an hour of meditation practice. The material draws on Frans's training since 2012 with the Japanese priest Takeda Hakusai Ajari.

courses.title: "Way of Reiki" Teachings with Frans Stiene
courses.description: A nine-hour video course that works through the practices in Frans's book The Way of Reiki, including kenyoku ho, joshin kokyu ho, seishin toitsu, hatsurei ho and hands-on healing as meditation. Suitable for practitioners and teachers who want a more traditional Japanese approach.

courses.title: What is Reiki?
courses.description: Seven one-hour video lessons for existing practitioners and teachers of all lineages, covering elements of Shoden, Okuden and Shinpiden. Topics include the precepts, hatsurei ho, aspects of the symbols and mantras, and hands-on/off healing.

courses.title: Esoteric Japanese Mantra Journey
courses.description: A five-hour video teaching introducing several Japanese mantras, with an explanation of each and around thirty minutes of chanting per session. Intended to support the personal practice of Reiki practitioners and teachers.

courses.title: Online Video Reiki Retreat
courses.description: Six hours of recorded teaching in two-hour blocks, designed to be used as a personal Reiki retreat at home. Practices include joshin kokyu ho and seishin toitsu, approached from a traditional Japanese perspective.

courses.title: Teaching and Practicing Shoden Reiki I
courses.description: Six hours of video teaching for existing Reiki teachers on how Frans practises and teaches Shoden (Level I). It does not include a Shoden certificate, which requires an in-person course.

courses.title: Teaching and Practicing Okuden Reiki II
courses.description: Six hours of video teaching for existing Reiki teachers covering all the Okuden (Level II) practices and how to pass them on to students. It does not include an Okuden certificate, which requires an in-person course.

courses.title: Shoden Reiki I (English) | Haarlem Netherlands | 16-17 January 2027
courses.description: A two-day, in-person first-level course with Frans Stiene in Haarlem, taught in English. Students learn a daily self-practice and Japanese hands-on techniques to share with friends and family.

courses.title: Okuden Reiki II (English) | Haarlem | 21-22 November 2026
courses.description: A two-day, in-person second-level course with Frans Stiene in Haarlem, taught in English. It deepens practice through the shirushi (symbols) and jumon (mantras) and is open to Level I graduates of any lineage.

courses.title: Okuden Reiki II (English) | Haarlem | 30-31 January 2027
courses.description: A two-day, in-person second-level course with Frans Stiene in Haarlem, taught in English. It deepens practice through the shirushi (symbols) and jumon (mantras) and is open to Level I graduates of any lineage.

courses.title: Shinpiden Reiki III | Cheltenham UK | 6-8 November 2026
courses.description: A three-day Shinpiden (Level III) course with Frans Stiene focused on 'being Reiki', exploring the fourth symbol and mantra and their roots in Japanese esoteric traditions such as Zen, Shugendo and Tendai. Open to Okuden graduates and existing Reiki teachers of any lineage; graduates may go on to teach and receive free post-course online training.

courses.title: Shinpiden Reiki III | Barcelona, Spain | 11-13 February 2027
courses.description: A three-day Shinpiden (Level III) course with Frans Stiene focused on 'being Reiki', exploring the fourth symbol and mantra and their roots in Japanese esoteric traditions such as Zen, Shugendo and Tendai. Open to Okuden graduates and existing Reiki teachers of any lineage; graduates may go on to teach and receive free post-course online training. Taught in English with Spanish translation.

Open to Okuden graduates and existing Reiki teachers of any lineage; graduates may go on to teach and receive free post-course online training.

courses.title: Cincinnati Residential Reiki Retreat | 21-24 May 2027
courses.description: A four-day residential 'Way of Reiki' retreat with Frans Stiene, open to all lineages and levels. It combines traditional Japanese Reiki practices with the esoteric Japanese practices behind Mikao Usui's teachings, including chanting, breathing and visualisation meditations, reiju and hands-on healing.

courses.title: 3 Day Reiki Retreat | Sardinia, Italy | 11-13 June 2027
courses.description: A three-day retreat in Sardinia, open to everyone, taught in English with Italian translation. Frans teaches sitting and moving meditations, chanting and old Shinto, Shugendo and Buddhist practices to deepen understanding of Mikao Usui's teachings and the Reiki symbols and mantras.

free_resources.title: Reiki Meditations and Techniques
free_resources.description: A free International House of Reiki page with step-by-step instructions for foundational Japanese Reiki practices, including Kaiji Tomita's 1933 version of Hatsurei Ho and Kenyoku Ho. It includes a short audio of a waka poem in Japanese for use in the practice.

free_resources.title: The Reiki Precepts
free_resources.description: A free page setting out the Reiki precepts in English and in romanised Japanese, with a downloadable audio recording of the full precepts and background on their origins. A practical starting point for daily precept recitation.

free_resources.title: The Compassion Room
free_resources.description: A free guided compassion meditation, available as written instructions and as an audio download, based on the precept 'be compassionate to yourself and others'. It focuses on self-kindness and self-care as the ground for helping others.

free_resources.title: Frans Stiene on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Frans's free Insight Timer profile, with three chanting recordings of around twenty minutes each: the Reiki precepts in Japanese, the Mantra of Light (Kōmyō Shingon) and the Fudō Myōō mantra. Listeners can chant along or sit in meditation.

notes: Fresh research, 30 Oct 2026 (the old audit set aside, owner). Books are already on the listing.

Books added (owner, 30 Oct 2026): Discovering Reiki, and the three co-written with Bronwen (listed on Amazon as Bronwen Stiene), with Bronwen Logan as co-author. Not added: Beginning Reiki, Beginning Healing (already on Bronwen's listing), Die Wurzeln des Reiki (German), and the new editions of books already listed.
Left out at review: the Grounding Room page (its own page mentions recovery from illness).
The 12 videos on Mikao Usui's page are all from Frans's channel; moving them is a separate step (move_from_mikao_usui in the research file).

move_from_mikao_usui: all 12 return oEmbed 200 with author_name 'International House of Reiki' (Frans's own channel, @InternationalHouseofReiki). In every one Frans is the speaker/teacher: descriptions name him (Power of Healing series eps 5-10 are his short-teaching series; C3AS is his talk for the Australian Reiki Connection; STgaR is the Reiki Rays summit interview; OlNVedOCYok is Maria Kammerer interviewing him). 'Grounding Technique' and 'Reiki Language' descriptions don't name him but are first-person teachings on his channel; I did not watch them, so frans_teaches=true there is inferred.

Of the 12 moved videos, four are under ~2 minutes (Grounding Technique 1:48, Healing is Love 1:24, Feeling drained 1:33; Reiju 2:19 is borderline), which would fail the brief's 2-minute rule if re-checked for Frans's page.

Videos: all 20 checked oEmbed 200. Ranked by view count across his main channel (101 uploads), his second channel @ihreiki4079 (mostly duplicates) and YouTube search for interviews where he teaches. View counts: yqbE3tWub80 42K, _3wHQawZ5hU 21K, l27p9dknvpk 14K, N7I6uxMjgeU 13K (Firefly Society), mgbIawvt7vM 11K, Gxw9dr0B8Rk 7.5K (O-Books), 8P-ZxPzLJSA 6.4K, BGK5OpDe3VU 3.6K, VdNpq-cFl9I 2.8K (Dive Into Reiki, Nathalie Jaspar), no7_xmyC7hE 2.6K, oCi5WL_efOM 2.6K, zAcc66IwMgs 2.5K, then IHReiki uploads of 2.3K down to ~950.

Videos left out: book/CD promo clips under 2 minutes (The Japanese Art of Reiki, Your Reiki Treatment, The Book of Five, etc.); two 'Reiki Music Video' uploads (music); 'Can you feel this? Reiki Healing Energy' (no teaching, background music); 'Testing Reiki Brainwaves' and its response (not teaching); retreat promo reels; Dutch-language uploads; mantra chants (Heart Sutra, Light Mantra, Fudo Myoo) to keep the list on teaching; Gnostic TV 'LEGIT REIKI' (trailer for a paid programme); b4WHdqX_xqU 'What is Reiki ?' (69K views) on the 'Meditation & Healing House' channel looks like a re-upload of his own fpqXuI8kkBg (same 1:17:23 length), so I used his own upload instead.

Borderline video choices: yqbE3tWub80 (2:41) and mgbIawvt7vM (2:21) are short chanting practices rather than talks; l27p9dknvpk is a 20-minute chanting practice. 'Frans Stiene discusses his own healing journey' is about his travels and training, with no medical content in the description. Drop any of these if chanting doesn't count as teaching.

Courses: prices copied from each page. The site has a currency switcher, but product schema gives native currencies (EUR/USD/GBP) and I used those. Event price ranges (e.g. €575 – €1,225) cover lump sum, instalments and graduate resit fees; the full fee is the top figure. Lancaster lists 'US$1,425 - US$713 - US$356 - US$356 - US$665'; I used the lump sum US$1,425 USD.

Courses left out: Cheltenham 4-day Being Reiki Retreat (30 Oct-2 Nov 2026, US$884), already under way today; Haarlem Okuden 29-30 Aug 2026 (past); 'Online Video Reiki Retreat 2026' 4-hour download (£180 GBP), '9 Hour Online Retreat 2024' (€300 EUR) and 'Rediscovering Your Inner Dragon | 25-29 February 2024' (€108 EUR), downloads with dates in their titles (could be added if dated titles are acceptable); a large back catalogue of single webclasses/teleclasses on https://ihreiki.com/downloads/; and the three correspondence programmes (Remembering Program, 21 Day Reiki Program, Enhancing the Three Diamonds), which are narrated by Bronwen Logan and probably belong on her listing.

Private sessions (note only, per task): 'Online Meditation or Teaching Session with Frans Stiene', a half-hour private WhatsApp session with reiju, US$65 USD (https://ihreiki.com/product/live-online-meditation-session/); 'Online Private Teachings with Frans Stiene' (https://ihreiki.com/product/live-online-private-teachings/, price not checked); 'Online Group Teachings with Frans Stiene', a one-hour session for your own group, €190 EUR; and 'One-on-One Training with Frans Stiene' (Europe page).

No membership other than the Virtual Practice Evenings found. Shibumi International Reiki Association (shibumireiki.org) would not load (connection failed), so I couldn't check it. I found no personal website for Frans separate from ihreiki.com. No free course or podcast of his own: his podcast appearances are on other people's shows (Dive Into Reiki, Reiki Radio, Be the Light).

Free resources: the IHReiki 'Grounding Room' page also contains health-claim wording ('recovery from illness'); my description leaves it out, but drop the item if the page itself is a problem. The Insight Timer tracks are labelled 'Music' by Insight Timer, but they are chanting practices. I didn't confirm whether each IHReiki info page was written by Frans or by Bronwen.

Other books by Frans on Amazon (not added, per task): Discovering Reiki: Be The Light of Gratitude and Kindness (B0HLPWGSHM, new); Your Reiki Treatment, with Bronwen Stiene (1846940133); A-Z of Reiki Pocketbook, with Bronwen Stiene (1905047894); Reiki Techniques Card Deck, with Bronwen Stiene (1905047193); Beginning Reiki, Beginning Healing (B00E03W9F2, Kindle); Die Wurzeln des Reiki (389767372X, German). The Inner Heart of Reiki NEW EDITION (1803419105) and a new Reiki Sourcebook edition (1803419075 / B0FPSLKVYQ) are new editions of books already on Spiritpedia.

books.title: Discovering Reiki: Be The Light of Gratitude and Kindness
books.author: Frans Stiene
books.description: Frans Stiene's newest book, on the heart of the system of Reiki. It explores gratitude and kindness as our true nature, and how living from them lets our energy flow freely.

books.title: Your Reiki Treatment: How to Get the Most Out of It
books.author: Bronwen Stiene and Frans Stiene
books.description: Reiki from the client's side: how to prepare for a treatment, what happens during it and how to carry it on afterwards. Short two-page chapters in three parts make it easy to dip into.

books.title: A–Z Reiki Pocketbook: Everything You Need to Know About Reiki
books.author: Bronwen Stiene and Frans Stiene
books.description: A compact reference set out like an address book, from what Reiki is and where it came from to the practices used today. Each question is answered at the flick of a page.

books.title: Reiki Techniques Card Deck: Heal Yourself Intuitively
books.author: Bronwen Stiene and Frans Stiene
books.description: A deck of Reiki practices chosen from traditions around the world, one technique per card. No earlier Reiki training is needed to use it.
